MOREOVER, WE HAVE A WARNING LEAFLET IN EACH BLISTER WHICH DECLARES: "NEVER USE ORGANIC SOLVENTS SUCH AS ALCOHOL DIRECTLY ON THE CATHETER, IT MAY WEAKEN THE MATERIAL. A REVIEW OF THE BATCH HISTORY RECORDS FOR (8137379 AND 8178394) WAS PERFORMED, AND NO DEVIATIONS WERE FOUND. THE BATCHES COMPLIED TO ITS SPECIFICATIONS AND WERE RELEASED.
